title: Table 1a, 5 by 5, mask 16223860: representing it takes at least 11 AND/OR gates of fan-in at most two
statement: ¬ PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun u v : Fin 5 => (16223860 : ℕ).testBit (5 * u.val + v.val)) 10
unlocks: one entry on representing a five-by-five bipartite graph where a shared OR gate is known to help: 10 gates or 11, truth not known
context: SKETCH: truth not known to us; the opposite row is offered beside it. This side says 10 gates are not enough. All 10 lines must be read, and a 10-gate circuit has exactly one node read twice beyond a tree; a proof rules out each place that node can sit, or is a finite search with a certificate the kernel replays. A conjecture of ours, on paper, predicts this side. Size: unknown. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.
